title: [UE-0.4b] Packaging-machine [VERIFY] items, first test upload
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Technical Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

QA and Build

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `pipeline/unreal-rules.md`, `pipeline/unreal/`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `pipeline/unreal-rules.md`, `pipeline/unreal/`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.2, UE-0.4a, UE-0.8

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

none (no later card lists it in After)

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `tools\ue\build.ps1` with `-DisableUnity -NoPCH -NoSharedPCH` exits 0 on the packaging machine (Runs on: the Windows packaging machine: a kickoff there (`tools\kickoff.ps1`) builds and fixes this card, a kickoff elsewhere leaves it waiting (`tools/kickoff.py` RUNS_ON_WINDOWS))
- [ ] Each packaging [VERIFY] item (non-unity flags, `-abslog`, BUILD_INFO platform folder, Maps cooked from `MapsToCook`) has its tag removed or its rule rewritten, with the log line pasted
- [ ] The agent builds the Development zip of `main` and writes the exact `butler push` line and its sha256 on the card
- [ ] HUMAN submission: by the Clock G1 time, the packaging and submission owner uploads that zip to the team's Draft itch project (Official Rules §17: never an agent)
- [ ] The card's session unzips that zip into a new folder outside the build tree and launches it with `$env:SMOKE_ZIP="ZIP"; tools\ue\smoke.ps1 -Exe EXE` on the unzipped copy (it writes the `LAUNCH` record line the gate record needs)
- [ ] The agent posts `Itch test upload: LINK sha256=HASH` on the tracker, and `check_card.py --status` exits 0 after G1 (D-new-upload-g1)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
